name: multilingual-stemmer
description: Стемминг: 35 языков и Early Modern English, 36 алгоритмов Snowball 3.2.0 в WebAssembly. TypeScript · Node.js · Browser · Без runtime-зависимостей.
author: Vladislav Tupikin <vladislav.tupikin@icloud.com>

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.compile:wasm: pnpm exec wasm-pack build ./rust-stemmers --out-dir ../dist/browser --release --target web --out-name index
scripts.compile: pnpm run clean && pnpm run compile:wasm && tsx prepare.ts && pnpm run compile:ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run compile && pnpm run optimize
